bearing.gui.contraptions.network_overstr: This network is _overloaded_: demand exceeds supply. Add more power sources or _lower the speed_ of stress-hungry machines.

item.bearing.wrench.tooltip.summary: All-round tool for adjusting and servicing kinetic machinery.
item.bearing.wrench.tooltip.behaviour1: _Turns the block_ around the face you clicked. Use while _sneaking_ to _pick it up_.
item.bearing.wrench.tooltip.behaviour2: _Moves_ an assembled minecart or train contraption elsewhere.
item.bearing.goggles.tooltip.summary: Adds _extra readouts_ to your HUD for the machines you look at.
item.bearing.goggles.tooltip.behaviour1: _Kinetic blocks_ report the _stress they add_ or the _capacity they supply_. A _Stressometer_ sums up the _whole network_ it sits on. Other blocks may list the items and fluids they hold.
br.goggles.overlay.reset: Goggle Overlay has been reset to default position
br.goggles.overlay.needs_client: The overlay position can only be changed with the Bearing client mod.
